title: Local noise tests remain subtle; broad cleanup stays on hold.
summary: New tests change the marked episode 1 picture only slightly. They do not yet separate unwanted outline noise from real drawing, so the current version remains the reference.
problem: Small shifting speckles near outlines can resemble legitimate fine detail. Broad cleanup risks softening the drawing.
response: Keep the new tests local and experimental. Require a confirmed noise halo and a nearby line to preserve before preparing training examples.
beforeDetail: Untreated DVD action frame: comb-like stripes cross the moving character.
afterDetail: The same frame with field matching: stripes are reduced. This is a field-processing test, not a newly trained model.
imageNote: Reference image from 4 November, not today’s noise test. No new pair was verified for publication: the latest boards mix diagnostic masks and different tests, and do not establish selective noise removal.
stageNote: Step 3 of the four-step review cycle: check the result and retain the better-supported version.
nextStep: Review fine noise and preservation markings, then test independent scenes in motion. Ending-credit flicker also remains under review.
